summary:
# BOOK 1: "The Boys of Grand Pré School" (De Mille, Gutenberg 56232)

Setting: Grand Pré Academy, Nova Scotia; school headed by Dr. Porter. Teachers: Mr. Simmons (math, minerals), Mr. Long (English; defends Corbet; stern and then kind). Chapters I–XXIII.

**Main boys ("B. O. W. C." = secret society):** Bart Darner (leader, inventive, curly golden hair, jokester), Bruce Rawdon (eldest, strong, superstitious about ghosts, brave, heart trouble later), Arthur Rawdon (Bruce's brother), Tom Crawford, Phil Kennedy (small, fearless).
**Other boys:** Jiggins (grave, solemn, "I have my doubts"), Bogud (David Digg, geology, "Digg"), Billymack (William MacNamara), Johnny Blue (Peter Fraser), Muckle (George McLeod), Sammy Ram Ram (George Henderson), Pat (Michael Murphy, Irish, mischievous, pole, porcupine).
**Servants/others:** Solomon (aged African cook, dialect, "Perpetual Grand Panjandrum", chatters, "Bee See Double"), Captain Corbet (venerable, Antelope schooner owner, dialect "Wal", baby ("babby"), wife Mrs. Corbet; mineral rod; treasure hunt), Old Zeke (witness, rat), Pieter Schwab (justice of the peace, Dutch), Dennis O'Rafferty (Irish, Scott's Bay/Five Islands; dead son Michael, d. June 5, 1845; wife Mary/"Molly"), Captain Pratt (Pratt's Cove, bluff, jolly), Mr. Smalley, Mr. Atkins, Bennie Grigg (Scott's Bay host), Mrs. Bennie, Mate Wade (wife "Gipson"), Mr. Brown (wall owner), Mr. Slocum (owner of owl), Harry Thompson, Mrs. Pratt.

**Ch I:** Spring recess; camp in woods (dam, pool). Solomon's lunch, departs. Boys make bows/arrows/whistles. Captain Corbet arrives, shows "mineral rod" (stick), coin "LOUIS XIV. ROI DE FRANCE"; claims pot of gold in cellar of "Old French Orchard"; says babby motive. Bart cites Benedict Bellefontaine, wealthiest farmer of Grand Pré.

**Ch II:** Description of Grand Pré view (Blomidon, Minas Basin, Cornwallis, Gaspereau). Acadian expulsion history; Evangeline. Rod falls over cellar center. Bruce wants daytime; Bart insists midnight, magic numbers 7 or 3s, Book of Magic. Bruce secretly fearful.

**Ch III:** Midnight dig. Lights (candles in pails, kettles, baskets; "the Bust" phrenological bust). Solomon guards lights. Latin/Euclid/English incantations; hymn to tune "Rousseau's Dream." Bruce's pickaxe hits metal. Sudden roar; panic; all flee. Solomon runs, barricades room. Bruce returns courageously; they bury hole. Corbet snaps rod, "warning"; says babby.

**Ch IV:** Sunrise description. Mr. Long asks boys to unload Antelope ballast (stone wall of Mr. Brown) and rebuild; reward: holidays. Antelope aground in Mud Creek on side, sinks. Corbet: "gone sucker," "Providence." Mr. Long: Corbet served writ; Mr. Long promises defense.

**Ch V:** Noise in garret; Pat suspected. Bart spies; Pat's room under Bart's. Bart investigates alone.

**Ch VI:** Trial before Pieter Schwab. Prosecutor claims $500 damage; witness Old Zeke (rat, "wouldn't swear it wasn't a rat"). Mr. Long demolishes case; "baby" speech. Dismissed.

**Ch VII:** Ridge Road; Gaspereaux valley; boys fish (trout); Gaspereaugians (enemy farm boys) absent; camp found invaded by Gaspereaugians.

**Ch VIII:** Bart and Solomon ambushed, captured; Bart jests, frees hands; Bruce wrestles big Gaspereaugian (underhold, throws into pool). Gaspereaugians retreat ("Exeunt omnes").

**Ch IX:** Lunch at camp; roar again; boys search; it is a donkey (Dr. Porter's, bought from scissor-grinder) braying; Solomon laughs. Boys decide to dig again.

**Ch X:** Solomon's speeches. Dig; find iron plate: rusty ploughshare, colter, bolts, chain, iron pot, nails, 13 copper sous ("UN SOU"), bone. Boys present to Dr. Porter; he laughs.

**Ch XI:** Dr. Porter proposes excursion to Blomidon French fort. Morning drive; Cornwallis description; Dr. Porter lectures on Acadian history (Port Royal 1606, Utrecht 1713, neutrals, 1755 expulsion, Halifax, Boston contractors Apthorp & Hancock).

**Ch XII–XIII:** Forest march; Barrens; boys lost; Dr. Porter lost; ledge/cliff sounds of surf.

**Ch XIV:** Party splits: Bruce (Scott's Bay) with Bart, Arthur, Tom, Phil, Pat; Dr. Porter with Jiggins, Bogud, Sammy, Johnny, Billymack. Pat chases porcupine with pole, lost. Bruce's party recovers Pat on road.

**Ch XV–XVI:** Dr. Porter reunites with Bruce's party; both circled. Bennie Grigg's cottage: "Scott's Bay." Bennie's grand supper. Sunday at Scott's Bay; doctor confesses error. Monday return; school late, extra holiday.

**Ch XVIII–XXI:** Garret haunting: Pat's owl (Mr. Slocum's screech owl) and Pat's string-bell tricks; boys rig donkey to garret; donkey brays; Pat flees. Solomon's indignation; owl to be boiled. Mr. Long lectures; Captain Corbet with baby interrupts; relics displayed; Bruce's speech; Bart's poem "True Theory of the Bone" (Parley Yoo leg). Relics in Museum.

**Ch XXII–XXIII:** Dr. Porter's lecture on Acadians, Louisbourg (first siege 1745, Pepperell). Antelope found afloat-ish; Captain Pratt (stout jolly master) raises Antelope with tackles; boys haul "Hi ho, cheerly, men!"

**Ch XXIV:** Pat left with baby; Mrs. Corbet returns; Corbet sails with potatoes to Boston, "exile"; Antelope vanishes into fog.

# BOOK 2: "The B. O. W. C." (De Mille, Gutenberg 56231)

Chapters I–XX (text ends mid-XXIII of Book 1 framing; book ends with "THE END").

**Ch I:** May meeting in Rawdons' rooms; ceremonial costume (white sheets; Bart's red shirts with white crosses, felt hats with feathers, skull flag "B. O. W. C."). Origin of society: Bart's runaway history; Dr. Porter's treatment; Bart's inventions (steamboat from clock, tin band). Officers: Most Venerable Patriarch, Venerable Scribe, Right Worshipful Commander, Grand Scholastic, Venerable Warden. Solomon made "Perpetual Grand Panjandrum." Phrenological bust.

**Ch II:** Grand Pré and Minas Basin description; procession with Solomon in cart; camp in woods (dam, pool); flag hoisted. Dr. Porter offers schooner cruise (Antelope, Captain Corbet) around Minas Basin for minerals (Messrs. Simmons, Long).

**Ch III:** Procession to Mud Creek; crew: Pat (sky-blue coat, silk hat), Johnnie Blue (pea-jacket), Bogud (overcoat, nightcap), Muckle (red soldier coat), Jiggins (gray homespun, red bandana), Billymack (tail coat), Sammy Ram Ram. Mr. Brown's stone wall taken as ballast. Corbet absent with baby; Mrs. Corbet away; Corbet tries to delay. Owner Brown shouts. Black flag raised; Bruce fires pistol.

**Ch IV:** Blomidon ("Blow me down"); Simmons on tides; Captain Kidd jeer from schooner; songs ("Three blue-bottles," "Farmer's Boy"); seasickness; Pinnacle Island; Five Islands landing; climbing cliffs.

**Ch V:** Exploring island; Bruce on cliff for gull's nest; root snaps, shelf falls; Bart and Arthur haul him up. Mr. Long kisses Bruce. Boat sculling; Bruce rows, rope dropped; Bruce collapses ("I'm dying!"); boat drifts into fog.

**Ch VI:** Search: Mr. Long blows fog-horn; Corbet navigation talk; anchor; Mr. Long prays; dawn; Antelope drifted back to Grand Pré; Blomidon search; black flag kept flying.

**Ch VII:** Boat adrift; Tom and Phil paddle; land on rock with seaweed; Arthur leaps with rope; boat towed ashore. Camp built on island; lobster baked in stones (Micmac method); 13 lobsters later; boys tired of lobster.

**Ch VIII:** Gulls' eggs; camp of spruce; signal staff (Phil climbs tree; red shirt flag). Boys complain of lobster. Plans to explore.

**Ch IX:** Exploration: O'Rafferty's goose shot by Bart (pistol); Dennis O'Rafferty (Irish fisherman; son Michael d. 1845; wife Molly). Breakfast at his house (potatoes, bacon). Dennis fetches Phil; grave in enclosure, "Requiescat in Pace."

**Ch X:** Phil's omelet attempts; signal fire; schooner sighted; Mr. Long throws sandwiches; boys rescued; O'Rafferty gets hatchet with initials; boys sail to Pratt's Cove.

**Ch XI:** Pratt's Cove; Captain Pratt (stout, bluff); dinner ruined — Sammy and Johnny ate all food; song "Bingo" (B-I-N-G-O); Pratt's sawmill; boys sleep at Pratt's house; schooner gone adrift (anchor broke off).

**Ch XII:** Pat catches duck (Johnny, hook bait) and Sammy stole a roaster pig; cooked together; Pat's ignorance: throws minerals (wrapped stones) into mud; Jiggins, Muckle join.

**Ch XIII:** Boys adrift on schooner; Bart steers poorly; runs ashore on mud flat near headland to avoid rocks; confesses ignorance.

**Ch XIV:** Shovel-mouth shark (dog fish) fight on sand-spit: Arthur clubs with handspike; Bruce and Bart spear with boat-hooks; jaws kept as trophy; sculpin in belly. Schooner aground again; quilts as togas; drifting; boys wait.

**Ch XV:** Pat ate raw clams (poison to Mrs. Pratt's lore: months without "R"); Jiggins scratched clams; Mrs. Pratt's medicine chest (list); boys dosed.

**Ch XVI:** Schooner (strange green) seen; passes by; boys go out again; Bart and Arthur swim to Antelope, fail; drift again; Mr. Long returns with boat; Phil, Tom rejoin; Mr. Long cross with schooner; "sculpin" jokes.

**Ch XVII–XVIII:** Search for Pat's lost specimens; Pat threw stones into mud; Mr. Long, dramatic search with torches; clam shell found ("A clam!"). Antelope leaves with baby talk of Corbet, mate Wade sleeping; cold water wake-up; Corbet's theory of compass ("Paul had a compass"); Corbet's babby ("Bo-rax!").

**Ch XIX–XXI:** Corbet's songs; mud flat; boys sing "Should Captain Corbet be forgot" parody; drift; Mr. Long lands alone to find minerals; Corbet's spyglass fragment.

**Ch XXII–XXIII:** Wind comes; Antelope aground on mud flat near Grand Pré; boys walk across mud (Phil loses boot; quagmire; Tom sinks; Bart and Bruce swim river; Bruce's heart "doldrum"); return to Academy; Solomon's greeting; banquet. END.
